claim: Before hooking a plotter, find all its callers and every writer of the undo pointer, since a second call site can reach it past the hook.

evidence.text: A mirrored copy of the player is drawn through the same plotter by other call sites and a switched undo buffer.
The dragon energy bar is drawn by 0x8A0C through 0x82E4, past the figure hook, so it stays in the ULA.
